config.design: Complete four-by-four factorial of first/second source identities (receiver0, donor1, donor2, donor3), native L1 MLP-output swaps. All16 combinations for every H791 item/format. Candidate logits/logprobs; additive prediction from single-source arms; coherent versus mixed composition.
config.prediction: Independent content contributions predict joint candidate contrasts from single-source arms. A coherence-sensitive interaction yields systematic residual differences between equal and unequal donor identities. Such residuals do not by themselves identify an equality detector.
config.limitations: Reused panel for compositional discovery, native output changes differ in norm; other residual paths remain receiver-native. Downstream nonlinearities can generate interactions without a discrete agreement gate.
config.primary_metric: Logit interaction I(a,b)=delta_logits(a,b)-delta_logits(a,0)-delta_logits(0,b); evaluate mean target donor(s) contrast against other nonreceiver candidates.
